page.layout: Two parallel columns of running text, left and right. Below the right column, one full-width italic line completes its last sentence. No margin notes. Top of page: page number at left, running head centred.

main_text.p: sulasquoque inferi maris, Corsi-cam, Sardiniam, Siciliam, quae omnia piae memoriae Pipinus avus, deinde Carolus Imperator genitor noster, per Atheniu[?] & Mainardum Abbates, ad hoc sponte missos, B. Petro eiusque successoribus scripto concesserunt, nos item probamus atque concedimus. Praeterea summi Pontificis deligendi Romano consilio potestatem esse volumus, modo sine discordia fiat, ac post consecrationem legati ad nos successoresque nostros Reges Francorum conciliandae charitatis & amicitiae causa mittantur: sicuti temporibus Dom. Caroli atavi, & Pipini avi, & postremo Caroli genitoris nostri mos fuit. Hanc igitur voluntatem nostram scripto ac iurejurando firmamus, & per legatum S.R.E. Theodorum domino Paschali misimus, manuque propria me subscripsi, EGO LU-DOVICUS. subscripsere quoque tres filii eius, Episcopi decem, Abbates octo, Comites quindecim, Bibliothecarius, Masionarius, Ostiariusque unus. nume-rabatur annus ab incarnatione Domini DCCCXXXV.

p.i: electione faciendi, nullusque in civitatibus aut territoriis ad ecclesiae B. Petri Apostoli potestate pertinentibus aliquod malum praeterea facere praesumat: sed liceat Romanis cum omnivene-ratione & sine qua-libert perturbatione honorifica suo pontifici exhibere sepulturæ: & eu quę divina inspiratione, & Beati Petri intercessione omnes Romani uno cōsilio atq; una cōcordia, sine aliqua promissione, ad pontificatus ordine elegerint, sine aliqua ambiguitate atq; contradictione more canonico consecrare:& dū cōsecratus fuerit, legati ad nos, vel ad nostros successores Reges Francorum dirigatur, qui inter nos & illum amicitiam, charitatem & pacem concilient.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Atheniu" (possibly Athenium with a tilde over the u); "libert perturbatione" (the word "libertate" appears to be abbreviated or run together, so the spacing is uncertain); "eu quę" (the tilde over the q is unclear). Tildes over o and u in cōsilio, cōcordia, cōsecratus and malū are read from the scan and may be slightly off. The running head has been changed from BRVTVM to BRUTUM under the u/v rule. The first line begins mid-word ("sulasquoque"), so the paragraph is marked as a continuation. The right column also begins mid-sentence ("electione faciendi"), and the same continuation applies there.
